scoring_justification: Only final aggregate band gaps and magnetic moments are reported; recompute from raw logs is infeasible. Result-level comparison against paper’s USPC values with per-compound tolerances is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported USPC band gaps (Table 1) and magnetic moments (Table 2) for MnO, FeO, CoO, NiO.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 “With uspc” row and Table 2 “With USPC” row.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper’s own published results used as the verification reference.

outputs.description: USPC-corrected band gaps (eV) and local magnetic moments (μB per metal atom) for the four antiferromagnetic oxides NiO, MnO, FeO, CoO.

output_contract.notes: The hidden verifier will compare the reported band gaps and magnetic moments against reference values from published experimental/theoretical work using per-compound tolerances that account for implementation-dependent spread.
